title: Shopify Partner Programme — app, theme and referral partners
description: Build apps or themes for the Shopify ecosystem, or refer merchants and earn recurring revenue. Open to agencies, freelancers and software companies worldwide. Revenue share on referred merchants and on paid app installs.

title: Stripe Partner Ecosystem — technology and consulting partners
description: Join as a technology partner building on Stripe APIs, or as a consulting partner implementing Stripe for clients. Includes co-marketing, referral fees and listing in the Stripe Partner Directory.

title: AWS Partner Network — consulting and software partners
description: Tiered partner programme for firms that resell, build on, or consult around AWS. Benefits include funding for proofs of concept, marketplace listing and co-sell support with the AWS field team.

title: HubSpot Solutions Partner Programme
description: For agencies and consultancies that implement, migrate and manage HubSpot for clients. Tiered commission on sold licences plus inbound lead routing from HubSpot to certified partners.

title: Paystack Partner Programme — developers and referrers
description: Integration and referral partnerships for developers, agencies and platforms serving African merchants. Includes revenue share on referred transaction volume.

title: Flutterwave Partnerships — platform and channel partners
description: Channel, technology and reseller partnerships for companies distributing payment infrastructure across African markets.

title: Cloudflare Partner Network — resellers and MSPs
description: Reseller, referral and managed service provider tracks for firms selling security and performance services. Deal registration, margin on resold plans and technical enablement included.

title: Twilio Partner Programme — ISV, consulting and technology
description: For independent software vendors embedding Twilio, consultancies delivering implementations, and technology companies building complementary products. Includes marketplace distribution.

title: Notion Partner Programme — consultants and template creators
description: Certified consultant track for agencies implementing Notion at scale, plus a creator track for paid template and integration distribution.

title: Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Programme
description: Solutions partner designations across data, security, infrastructure and business applications. Includes co-sell with Microsoft sellers and Azure Marketplace transactability.

title: Vercel Agency and Technology Partners
description: Agency partnerships for studios delivering front-end builds, and technology partnerships for platforms integrating with the Vercel deployment workflow. Includes inbound referrals.

title: Zoho Partner Programme — authorised resellers
description: Authorised partner and reseller programme with margin on licence sales and implementation services. Strong presence across Africa, India and the Middle East.
